item.title: From bzImage to Nested VMs: Building a Subaru DENSO Head Unit Debug Environment with QEMU/KVM
item.description: The Subaru DENSO head unit studied in this article is a system made up of multiple operating systems and dedicated hardware: a QNX Hypervisor, QNX Neutrino and Linux run on an Intel x86 platform, and the applications depend on graphics, audio, networking and an authentication chip. Debugging directly on such a production device runs into the problem of debugging conditions first: access to a shell, serial port and debugger is usually restricted, and a service crash or system reboot may interrupt normal use of the head unit. To repeatedly observe programs, compare configurations and collect crash scenes, a lab environment independent of the car is much more convenient.
